paragraphs.text: 1. I YOKE with prayer your ancient inspiration: may the laud rise as on the prince's pathway.
paragraphs.original: युजे वां ब्रह्म पूर्व्यं नमोभिर्वि श्लोक एतु पथ्येव सूरेः ।
paragraphs.translit: yuje vāṃ brahma pūrvyaṃ namobhirvi śloka etu pathyeva sūreḥ |

paragraphs.text: All Sons of Immortality shall hear it, all the possessors of celestial natures.
paragraphs.original: शृण्वन्तु विश्वे अमृतस्य पुत्रा आ ये धामानि दिव्यानि तस्थुः
paragraphs.translit: śṛṇvantu viśve amṛtasya putrā ā ye dhāmāni divyāni tasthuḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. When speeding ye came nigh us like twin sisters, religious-hearted votaries brought you forward.
paragraphs.original: यमे इव यतमाने यदैतं प्र वां भरन्मानुषा देवयन्तः ।
paragraphs.translit: yame iva yatamāne yadaitaṃ pra vāṃ bharanmānuṣā devayantaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Take your place, ye who know your proper station: be near, be very near unto our Soma.
paragraphs.original: आ सीदतं स्वमु लोकं विदाने स्वासस्थे भवतमिन्दवे नः
paragraphs.translit: ā sīdataṃ svamu lokaṃ vidāne svāsasthe bhavatamindave naḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Five paces have I risen from Earth. I follow her who hath four feet with devout observance.
paragraphs.original: पञ्च पदानि रुपो अन्वरोहं चतुष्पदीमन्वेमि व्रतेन ।
paragraphs.translit: pañca padāni rupo anvarohaṃ catuṣpadīmanvemi vratena |

paragraphs.text: This by the Sacred Syllable have I measured: I purify in the central place of Order,
paragraphs.original: अक्षरेण प्रति मिम एतामृतस्य नाभावधि सं पुनामि
paragraphs.translit: akṣareṇa prati mima etāmṛtasya nābhāvadhi saṃ punāmi

paragraphs.text: 4. He, for God's sake, chose death to be his portion. He chose not, for men's good, a life eternal
paragraphs.original: देवेभ्यः कमवृणीत मृत्युं प्रजायै कममृतं नावृणीत ।
paragraphs.translit: devebhyaḥ kamavṛṇīta mṛtyuṃ prajāyai kamamṛtaṃ nāvṛṇīta |

paragraphs.text: They sacrificed Brhaspati the Rsi. Yama delivered up his own dear body.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिं यज्ञमकृण्वत ऋषिं प्रियां यमस्तन्वं प्रारिरेचीत्
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatiṃ yajñamakṛṇvata ṛṣiṃ priyāṃ yamastanvaṃ prārirecīt

paragraphs.text: 5. The Seven flow to the Youth on whom the Maruts wait: the Sons unto the Father brought the sacrifice.
paragraphs.original: सप्त क्षरन्ति शिशवे मरुत्वते पित्रे पुत्रासो अप्यवीवतन्नृतम् ।
paragraphs.translit: sapta kṣaranti śiśave marutvate pitre putrāso apyavīvatannṛtam |

paragraphs.text: Both these are his, as his they are the Lords of both: both toil; belonging unto both they prosper well.
paragraphs.original: उभे इदस्योभयस्य राजत उभे यतेते उभयस्य पुष्यतः
paragraphs.translit: ubhe idasyobhayasya rājata ubhe yatete ubhayasya puṣyataḥ
